s1.text:
The fortress is built from a single piece of metal. No seams, no joints, no weakness in the architecture. This is the Iron's home — a monument to endurance.

The main gate is sealed with three bolts, each as thick as your arm. A ventilation shaft runs along the ceiling. A drainage channel cuts beneath the wall.
s1.imagePrompt: A massive fortress carved from a single piece of dark metal, no seams or joints, three enormous bolts on the gate, a ventilation shaft above, imposing military architecture, dark fantasy
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The bolts are tighter this time — the fortress remembers what you did to get in.

choices.text: Force the bolts — strength against iron

s2a.text:
Inside, the Iron's armory stretches before you. Shields of every size, each one dented but unbroken. The Iron trains by letting things hit it.

A weak point map hangs on the far wall — the Iron's own analysis of its armor gaps. It studies its own flaws to fix them. But you found them first.
s2a.imagePrompt: A vast armory filled with dented but unbroken shields of every size, a tactical map on the far wall showing armor weak points, military precision, dark fantasy

choices.text: Grab the heaviest weapon you can find
Your Guardian training reveals the shield's structural flaw

s2b.text:
The iron resists you. Your muscles burn, your hands ache. This fortress wasn't built to welcome visitors.

But the struggle teaches you something: iron bends under sustained pressure, not single blows. Patience, not power.
s2b.imagePrompt: Hands pushing against unyielding metal, muscles straining, the fortress resisting entry, determined struggle, dark fantasy

choices.text: Find a smarter way — brains over brawn

s2c.text:
The drainage channel is narrow, dark, and smells of rust. But it leads directly beneath the arena floor.

Through the grating above, you can see the Iron's routine: it practices blocking, over and over. Right side, left side, overhead. Always the same pattern.

Pattern. That's the key.
s2c.imagePrompt: Looking up through a rusty grating at a massive armored figure practicing blocking patterns, view from below through a drainage channel, dark industrial atmosphere, dark fantasy

choices.text: Count the pattern — memorize the rhythm
Rest in the dark — conserve your strength

s3.text:
The arena is a forge. Anvils ring the fighting pit. The heat is oppressive.

The Iron stands in the center, unmoving. A living statue. Waiting.

Its armor catches the forge light. Nothing gets through. But everything has a breaking point.
s3.imagePrompt: A forge arena with anvils ringing the fighting pit, oppressive heat haze, a massive iron guardian standing motionless in the center like a living statue, forge light reflecting off armor, dark fantasy

choices.text: Use the heat — iron weakens in fire
Match its endurance — grind it down
Find the gap in the armor — one precise strike
Tank every blow — prove your endurance exceeds its own

s4_final.text:
The Iron speaks, its voice like a hammer on an anvil:

"Nothing gets through."

It raises its shield. The challenge is simple: break what cannot be broken.
s4_final.imagePrompt: A massive titanium guardian raising an enormous shield, forge fire reflecting off impenetrable armor, anvils in the background, imposing boss encounter, dark fantasy
s4_final.ascensionText: The Iron pauses. Its shield arm lowers an inch — the first doubt you've ever seen in it. "You broke through once. The fortress has been reinforced."
